page.layout: One column of running text, full width. The printed page number is at the top right. No marginal notes; a bracket mark beside lines 15 to 17 is a printer's mark, not text.

main_text.p: Christianis profua[?] tyrannide omnia suffragia au-ferret. Aduersus Dei sanctos horrida bella, cruentasque pugnas, Antichristus iste parauit, irrumpentibus nouo pugnandi genere in Christi gregem tigridibus ac lupis. hos ut omnino sub cælo deleret hic Pharao, cum districtis gladijs, facibus accensis, poculisque toxicatis accurrebat. Nec à suis Cardinalibus, Fulgosio & Contareno, postquam Christi dulcedinem aliquantulum gustassent, manus abstinebat tyrannus: nec à Polensi episcopo Ioanne Baptista Vergerio, quos clàm veneno sustulit: nec ab eius fratre Paulo Vergerio, Iustinopolitano episcopo, nisi Dominus illum ad maiora ac meliora seruasset. In prouincijs Christianorum, sub hac immani bestia, ubique ferociebant Neronés & Maxentij, in ueritatis Dei professores: igne, ense, laqueis, remis, rogis, flammis, aquis, exilijs, carceribus, inedia, proscriptione, & similibus malorum diabolorum afflictionibus, ad mortes usque eos insequentes. Horum principes erant, Alexander Farnesius Cardinalis, & Octauius eius frater dux Parmensis, filij prædicti Petri, ac pontificis nepotes: qui inanes spirantes glorias, quum anno Domini 1546. ex Italia Germaniam essent ingressi, superbo comminabantur ore, se tantū Lutheranorum Germanicorum sanguinis fusuros, ut in eo possent natare eorum

page.notes: Line 1 "profua" is probably "pro sua" in print; read as shown with [?]. Line 15 "ferociebant" is read as the f form; the long-s/f shape is uncertain. Line 22 "inanes" is partly unclear at its start; read as "nanes" with the i of the line-end hyphen. Catchword "rum" is taken from the foot right, below the last line.
